This action is based on information received from Grasim Industries Limited (Birla Paints Division). The Company remains committed to fully cooperating with the CCI during the course of the investigation. You are requested to take the above information on record.

text: Sub: Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“Listing Regulations”) – clarification on news in mainstream media We write to you in relation to the news reports dated 4 th July, 2025 published in public domain, including NDTV article titled ‘ Ultratech Under Scanner In Cement Cartelisation Case’, which are false and misleading. It is clarified that the Company is not under investigation in this Case No. 35 of 2020 before the Competition Commission of India (“CCI”). The Company has neither received any order from the CCI in this case nor have the Company’s financials been sought by the CCI. The India Cements Limited (“ICEM”), a subsidiary of the Company, is party to Case No. 35 of 2020 and is separately making appropriate disclosures in this regard, while exploring legal options. UltraTech Cement reserves its rights to take necessary legal steps in light of these misleading reports to protect its reputation. The above is for your information and record.

text: Subject: Clarification letter Re: Your email dated June 2, 2025, regarding Clarification for Financial results - INFY We wish to inform you that, t he clause being referred is under Reg 33 (3)(e) is replicated below for reference: The listed entity shall also submit the audited or limited reviewed financial results in respect of the last quarter along-with the results for the entire financial year, with a note stating that the figures of last quarter are the balancing figures between audited figures in respect of the full financial year and the published year-to-date figures upto the third quarter of the current financial year Our response – As per the SEBI clause a note has to be given stating that the last quarter figures (Q4) is the balancing figure of year to date figures for the full year and the figures published till Q3 of that year.

Therefore, the Management appealed to the workmen to call off the illegal strike as resorting to a strike during the pendency of proceedings before the Industrial Tribunal is prohibited. McLeod Russel India Limited (the Company) wishes to clarify and address a recent market rumour on potential acquisition of the Company by Pheonix. This rumour has caused some volatility in the trading of the securities of the Company and created uncertainty among investors. The Company categorically states that the rumour is factually incorrect and misleading. The Company is committed to transparency and providing accurate information to investors. The Company regularly assesses various strategic opportunities and necessary disclosures will be made in accordance with the Listing Regulations as needed.

Ref: Stock Code: NSE: SHILPAMED/BSE‐530549 Shilpa Medicare announces the approval of Nor Ursodeoxycholic Acid Tablets 500 mg for the treatment of Non‐ Alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease in India Shilpa Medicare Limited announces the approval of its, Nor Ursodeoxycholic Acid (NorUDCA) Tablets 500 mg, by the Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO), marking a major milestone in innovative NAFLD therapy in India. This approval will allow Shilpa to become the first company in the World to launch this novel product in any part of the World for NAFLD. text: Sub: Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 – Receipt of Notice of Strike Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, we inform you that a strike notice has been issued by the Workers’ Union to take effect on or after September 3, 2025, demanding reinstatement of four dismissed workmen and a few who are under suspension. The dismissals were carried out after the charges of serious misconduct were proved through extensive enquiry processes and those under suspension are undergoing lawful enquiry processes for serious misconduct. As such, the call for a strike is considered inappropriate. The Company is in the process of applying for an injunction order in this regard and is taking all necessary measures to resolve the matter and ensure uninterrupted operations. Further updates will be provided in due course.

text: Subject: Update on temporary disruption of o perations at Kassar Plant, Bahadurgarh, Haryana In continuation of our earlier intimation dated 17th August, 2025, regarding the temporary disruption of operations at the Kassar Plant, Bahadurgarh, Haryana (“Plant”), we wish to provide the following update pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015: The supply of natural gas to the Plant, which was earlier fully disrupted on a temporary basis due to the incident in GAIL’s Gauna - Bawana pipeline, has now been partially restored. Accordingly, the operations at the Plant have been resumed in part. The Company is in the process of assessing other options for mitigating the disruption and to gradually scale up the production. All other manufacturing locations of the Company remain fully operational.

text: Sub: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 – Disruption of operations at our Roorkee plant due to natural calamity (floods) Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that operations at our manufacturing unit located in Roorkee, Uttarakhand, have been disrupted today due to heavy rains and flooding in the region. Partial production has resumed at the facility. Subject to no further adverse weather conditions, we expect to resume normal operations from Monday, August 25, 2025, as tomorrow is a scheduled weekly off. We are currently assessing any potential damage to assets. However, we wish to clarify that all assets are adequately insured.

text: Sub: Intimation about ﬁre happened in Unit-8 of the Company. text: Sub.: Rumour Verification: Regulation 30 (11) of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“the Listing Regulations”) Ref.: Clarification with respect to (i) certain mainstream media report s published today and (ii) increase in the market price of the Company’s equity shares today i.e. October 1, 2025 This has reference to the news article published today i.e. on October 1, 2025 in Economic Times titled “MUFG Sets Sights on 20% in Shriram Fin for $2.6 B ”. We hereby categorically deny the same. The said news and similar reports published today in certain mainstream media outlets are based on rumour and speculation. The increase or movement in the market price of the equity shares of the Company on Exchange of India Limited ( “Stock Exchanges” ) is absolutely market driven . The Management of the Company neither has any control nor has any knowledge of the reasons for this increase in the market price of its equity shares.

Unaudited Financial Results along with the Limited Review Reports thereon issued by the Statutory Auditors, M/s S.R. Batliboi & Co. LLP, Chartered Accountants. ii. Copies of investor presentation and press release. 2. Re-appointment of M/s Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP, as the Internal Auditors of the Company for a term of three consecutive financial years commencing from FY27 till FY29. The details as required in this regard are enclosed.

text: Sub: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 – Completion of tenure of Independent Directors. This is to inform that the tenure of Shri Shiv Tapasya Paswan (DIN: 09414240) and Shri Rohit Vaswani (DIN: 00658059), has been completed on 15th April, 2026 as Non-Official Director (Independent Director) of POWERGRID, in terms of respective orders of Ministry of Power dated 16th April, 2025. Upon completion of the said tenure, Shri Shiv Tapasya Paswan and Shri Rohit Vaswani ceased to be Non-Official Director (Independent Director) on the Board of POWERGRID from the said date. The above is informed i n terms of Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended. Kindly take the above on record.
